title: "Cannot save block will null data" with Freestyle Libre
symptom: After scanning a Freestyle Libre sensor with xDrip+, a 'Scanned OK!' toast appears but no data points are drawn on the graph. The events log shows 'LibreBlock Cannot save block will null data'.
cause: The user had 'Hardware Data Source' set to 'Libre Bluetooth' instead of 'LibreAlarm', which caused the NFC scan to read data but not process it correctly, leading to null data and the error.
fix: Change the Hardware Data Source setting to 'LibreAlarm'.
evidence_quote: Oh. It was so easy. Thanks. I had "Libre Bluetooth" selected.
